scope: Ordinary Rift starter-companion purchases, async selected-rig preparation, earned item consumption and persistent saved ownership. Formal jungle roles, ordinary practice camp calendars, native lifecycle calibration and full matches remain unfinished.

sourcePreparation.source: Frozen 16.18 item records and Data Dragon 16.18.1 item PNGs; Doran Blade group read from the digest-matched full item mirror.

sellVerification.cache: Verifier initially expected an absent legacy cache filename; a digest-checked copy of the already cached frozen Data Dragon mirror restored it. No source substitution.

lifecycle.starterGroup: One companion; conflicts with current Doran Blade. Persistent entitlement survives full-growth item consumption.
lifecycle.shopBinding: Current selected Smite requires a companion before other catalog equipment. All current catalog items are non-consumable; consumables and full role assignment remain unfinished.
lifecycle.sale: Rejected, including while dead; UI labels the item as unsellable.
lifecycle.creation: Separate owned actor with acquisition=purchase, createdTick captured at commit. Statless item does not create a neutral Unit.
lifecycle.firstEvolution: 15 earned feeds; starter stays in its current slot.
lifecycle.fullGrowth: 35 earned feeds; remove actual item slot, preserve other slot identities, trim only trailing holes, capture consumedTick=fullGrownTick.
lifecycle.afterConsumption: Actor, stage, final passive and starter-group reservation persist; other equipment can use the released slot. New match resets ownership.
lifecycle.deadOwner: Purchase and earned progression preserve death; full-growth consumption never grants health or a shield to a dead owner.

assets.preparation: Validate before load, await selected original rig, then revalidate current match/gold/capacity/ownership/fountain access before committing. Preparation failure spends nothing and retries.
assets.concurrency: UI serializes purchase clicks. Rig loader shares pending requests, removes only its own pending entry and caches successful preparation.
assets.unownedVariants: Not preloaded; a model explicitly prepared for a rejected transaction may remain cached for retry.

saves.purchaseAfterFull: No companion item remains; captured consumption equals earned full-growth tick.
saves.fixture: Free grants remain restricted to the controlled development Gromp encounter.
saves.restore: Ordinary purchased actors restore without requiring a development query; rigs prepare before play resumes.
rejects: Orphan item without ownership, or Doran conflict.
Premature/invented consumption or retained full-growth starter.

coverage: Original prices/groups/icons and zero stat grants.

assertions: All three variants bought for 450 via the ordinary real-Rift shop with selected F Smite.
No preloaded companion rigs; only the selected original GLB requested; Baby/Adult forms contribute GPU pixels.
Real F Smite kills a prepared actual Gromp, grants two feeds with bonus stock and starts the normal camp calendar.
First evolution keeps starter; full growth consumes it and frees space while retaining passive, evolved Smite and group reservation.
Exact ordinary-world purchase/camp/first/full checkpoints and restart into no ownership.
Asset 503 failure leaves full world snapshot unchanged; retry creates one actor and spends once.
Held asset request ignores repeated clicks, revalidates changed gold without charging and reuses the prepared model on legal retry.
Unsellable owned presentation and new catalog fit at 1280x720 and 600x700.
Eighteen preserved shop, recipe, sales, availability/focus/layout, Smite, ownership and passive regressions pass.
